historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi: a low-privilege principal must not receive another subject's privileged body on the same object URL.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET as caller A vs owner B

invariant: Caller A's response for object B must not contain B's secret.
attacker_capabilities: can authenticate as a low-privilege user

oracle.success_means: low-privilege arm returned the other subject's secret

severity_rationale: Two-arm IDOR: the owner arm is the metamorphic source; the low-privilege arm must not keep the secret.
